nature_language: 当前位置上海。我们四个人计划去武汉玩两天，预算6000元，市内交通主要使用地铁，开两间双床房。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Shanghai. Four of us are planning to visit Wuhan for two days with a budget of 6,000 RMB. We will primarily use the subway for transportation within the city and will book two twin-bed rooms. Please provide a travel plan.
